mapper.select: SELECT id, release_version, status, checksum, effective_from, published_at, rollback_of_release_version, change_summary FROM quant_config_release ORDER BY release_version DESC
SELECT id, release_version, status, checksum, effective_from, published_at, rollback_of_release_version, change_summary FROM quant_config_release WHERE release_version = #{releaseVersion}

SELECT v.id, v.config_code, v.config_version, v.schema_version, v.status, v.config_json::text AS config_json, v.checksum, v.effective_from, v.revision, v.remark, v.create_time, v.update_time FROM quant_config_release_item i JOIN quant_config_release r ON r.id = i.release_id JOIN quant_config_version v ON v.id = i.config_version_id WHERE r.release_version = #{releaseVersion} ORDER BY i.config_code

SELECT id, release_version, status, checksum, effective_from, published_by, published_at, rollback_of_release_version, change_summary, create_time, update_time, remark FROM quant_config_release WHERE effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY effective_from DESC, release_version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_config_release_item ( id, release_id, config_code, config_version_id, config_version, config_checksum, schema_version, create_time ) VALUES ( #{item.id}, #{item.releaseId}, #{item.configCode}, #{item.configVersionId}, #{item.configVersion}, #{item.configChecksum}, #{item.schemaVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
